source: estimate: the fixed-point engine counted on an rv32im model (tools/cpu), calibrated on 17 factory patches measured on the FM-1 (2026-10-20)

calibration.method: a scale and a fixed time per block, fitted to the factory patches measured on the FM-1 (survey, fit)
calibration.fit: device % = 1.041 x estimate + 0.8, 17 patches, peak of rest / 1 / 4 / 8 notes
calibration.acidM102Note: 303 Acid of M1-0.2 (b907693), one note held, peak cycles per block = 12 % of 2901 us (the ISR peak measured on the FM-1): the scale before the survey
calibration.benchNote: firmware/src/bench.c kernels (4x Q15 MAC 9 us, Q15 SVF 8 us per block, rounded down) give the same scale within a few %
calibration.note: module kits hold note 72; a square or saw oscillator costs more the higher it plays
